The comparison evaluates the performance of Danish regions and child and adolescent psychiatric departments on Indikator 2a, which measures the proportion of 0–5-year-olds receiving a clinical environmental observation within 120 days. The data spans multiple reporting periods, including 2021/22, 2022/23, 2023/24, and 2024/25, highlighting significant regional disparities and shifting compliance with national standards.

Nationally, the fulfillment rate for Indikator 2a has remained relatively stagnant, hovering around 60%. The national average was 61% in 2021/22, 63% in 2022/23, and 59% in 2023/24 [^src1], before ticking up slightly to 60% in 2024/25 [^src2]. Despite this stability at the macro level, individual regions and departments exhibit drastic variations.

**Leaders and Trailers**
[[region-syddanmark|Region Syddanmark]] consistently emerges as the top-performing region, achieving 91% in 2023/24 [^src1] and 88% in 2024/25 [^src2]. Within this region, specific departments such as [[aabenna-borne-og-ungdomspsykiatrisk-ambulatorium|Aabenraa: Børne og Ungdomspsykiatrisk Ambulatorium]] and [[vejle-bup-ambulatorium|Vejle: Børne- Og Ungdomspsykiatrisk Ambulatorium]] are standout leaders, both maintaining perfect 100% compliance across multiple consecutive years [^src1] [^src3]. 

Conversely, [[region-sjaelland|Region Sjælland]] frequently ranks as the lowest-performing region. Its compliance rate plummeted from 55% in 2021/22 to 23% in 2023/24 [^src1], and fell even further to 17% in 2024/25 [^src2]. At the departmental level, [[bornholm-bup-ambulatorium|Bornholm: Psykiatrisk ambulatorium, børn og unge]] recorded a 0% fulfillment rate in 2023/24 [^src1], while [[privathospitaler|Privathospitaler]] (including Hejmdal Privathospital) also scored 0% in the 2024/25 period [^src2] [^src3].

**Targets Met and Missed**
The tables track whether entities meet a specific national standard ("Standard opfyldt?"). In the 2023/24 period, only [[region-syddanmark|Region Syddanmark]] and [[region-midtjylland|Region Midtjylland]] successfully met the standard, while [[region-hovedstaden|Region Hovedstaden]], [[region-sjaelland|Region Sjælland]], and [[region-nordjylland|Region Nordjylland]] missed it [^src1]. By the 2024/25 period, the situation worsened at the regional level: every single region failed to meet the standard [^src2]. However, at the departmental level in 2024/25, [[vejle-bup-ambulatorium|Vejle]] and [[aabenna-borne-og-ungdomspsykiatrisk-ambulatorium|Aabenraa]] still managed to meet the target, unlike their peers in [[esbjerg-bup-ambulatorium|Esbjerg]] and [[odense-borne-og-ungdomspsykiatrisk-ambulatorium|Odense]] [^src3].

**Trends and Outliers**
While the national average remained flat, regional trajectories diverged sharply. [[region-hovedstaden|Region Hovedstaden]] showed notable improvement, rising from 33% in 2021/22 to 52% in 2023/24 [^src1], though it experienced a slight dip to 57% in 2024/25 [^src2]. [[region-nordjylland|Region Nordjylland]] also demonstrated recovery, climbing from 20% in 2022/23 to 42% in 2024/25 [^src2]. 

Notable outliers include the sudden collapse of compliance in [[region-sjaelland|Region Sjælland]] and the complete failure of [[privathospitaler|Privathospitaler]] to record any successful observations in the latest reporting year [^src2] [^src3]. Additionally, [[bua-smaborn-klinik|BUA Psykiatrisk Klinik for Småbørn]] (part of Region Midtjylland) maintained strong performance but ultimately missed the overarching standard in 2024/25 with an 86% fulfillment rate [^src3].

- "Der er et meget lavt antal patienter fra privathospitalerne, hvilket tyder på ukomplette data" — see [[data-quality|Data Quality]] ([[adhd-databasen|ADHD-DATABASEN]]) [^src8]
- "Der er massive problemer med registreringspraksis, således at udførte elementer ikke registreres" — see [[quality-assessment|Quality Assessment]] ([[adhd-databasen|ADHD-DATABASEN]]) [^src8]
- "Denne stigning er især drevet af resultatet i Midtjylland på 51 %, der er en stigning på 32 procentpoint sammenlignet med året før" — see [[performance-change|Performance Change]] ([[region-midtjylland|Region Midtjylland — Midtjylland]]) [^src20]
- "Syddanmark har også opnået en stigning fra 16 % i 2023/24 til 26 % i 2024/25" — see [[performance-change|Performance Change]] ([[region-syddanmark|Region Syddanmark — Syddanmark]]) [^src20]
- "53 % af de unge, som har været udredt for ADHD på et tidspunkt i databasens levetid (start 1/1 2013), og som i 2024 blev 17 år, har bestået folkeskolens afgangsprøve" — see [[educational-outcome|Educational Outcome]] ([[adhd-databasen|ADHD-DATABASEN]]) [^src21]
- "58 % af de unge, som i 2024 blev 17 år og er startet i et ADHD-behandlingsforløb på et tidspunkt i databasens levetid (start 1/1 2013), har bestået folkeskolens afgangsprøve" — see [[educational-outcome|Educational Outcome]] ([[adhd-databasen|ADHD-DATABASEN]]) [^src21]
